prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. Video 1 shows only the movement: she moves like the dealer in video 1, with the same timing. Her hand at the shoe strokes the yellow card out of the window and slides it flat on the felt, its broad yellow side up, to the middle in front of her, where her other hand meets it. There both hands tip the card up onto its short end, and her other hand, palm down, carries it on towards its place at the far left of the picture, where the last frame shows it; on that way the card goes on over the same short end, end over end, in one unbroken turn that begins with the yellow side up and ends with the blue side up. She lays the card flat at its place, blue side up, with her palm down, and her fingertips come to rest on it, as in the last frame. The hand from the shoe lets go once the card stands on its end and settles back at the shoe. Her head stays bowed and turns towards the place where the card will lie. Only one card moves: a small card, about half as long as her hand, which keeps the size it has in the last frame all the way from the shoe to its place. It is blank, solid yellow on one side and solid blue on the other, each colour reaching right out to its corners, and the next card in the window is the same blank yellow. To reach this far seat she rises a little from her seat and leans forward and to the left over the table, her arm lifted above the felt, as in the last frame.
